facts.command:
set -eu
printf 'enabled=%s\n' "$(systemctl is-enabled telemetry-heartbeat.service)"
printf 'active=%s\n' "$(systemctl is-active telemetry-heartbeat.service || true)"
printf 'failed=%s\n' "$(systemctl is-failed telemetry-heartbeat.service || true)"
systemctl show telemetry-heartbeat.service -p Result -p ExecMainCode -p ExecMainStatus --value
test ! -e /run/telemetry-heartbeat/heartbeat
